name: nobleseo
description: NobleSEO keyword clustering, evidence-backed content briefs, GSC performance reviews and charts.

interface.shortDescription: Keyword clusters, content briefs and GSC analysis
interface.longDescription: Review keyword clusters and evidence-backed content briefs through a separately configured NobleSEO MCP connection. Diagnose Google Search Console performance from exports or an available connector, and create GSC/GA4 charts. New research and clustering require approved previews.
defaultPrompt: Use $keyword-clustering to review my existing run and export a keyword map.
Use $seo-content-briefing to create a local brief from existing research.
Use $gsc-performance-review to diagnose changes in these GSC exports.
Use $gsc-visualization to chart daily clicks from my GSC export.
